description: Cross-language test vectors for verify_paper. Each vector lists build steps: records authored and signed by the named key in order, where the strings $id:<ref>, $did:<key>, $sch:<ref> and $sch:<ref>/<n> stand for a step's record id, a key's did:key, the sch: id of a genesis step and its sch:.../vN version id, and the optional flags sign_with (replace sig with another key's signature), tamper (set dotted paths after signing, leaving id and sig stale) and omit (leave the record out) corrupt a record after signing. Every implementation must derive each key's did_key from seed_hex alone and each vector's records, ids and call from build and arguments alone, then check that verify_paper(records, paper=, head=, authorities=) given call (paper and head are sch: ids or record ids, authorities are did:keys) reports expect: status, version_count, signers (key names in report order), genesis and head (refs into ids; null when none), checks (every check name -> passed) and supersessions (kind and applied, in report order: by kind, then record id). The verdict must not depend on record order.

authorized_signers.retraction: an author of the paper or a trusted authority
authorized_signers.correction: an author of the paper or a trusted authority

keys.name: alice
keys.description: signing seed = sha256(b'scholium-verification-vector-alice'); not a secret, a vector input

keys.name: bob
keys.description: signing seed = sha256(b'scholium-verification-vector-bob'); not a secret, a vector input

keys.name: carol
keys.description: signing seed = sha256(b'scholium-verification-vector-carol'); not a secret, a vector input

keys.name: mallory
keys.description: signing seed = sha256(b'scholium-verification-vector-mallory'); not a secret, a vector input

keys.name: committee
keys.description: signing seed = sha256(b'scholium-verification-vector-committee'); not a secret, a vector input

vectors.name: verified-single-version
vectors.description: One version by alice, listed authors alice and bob, both consented: verified.

vectors.name: verified-three-versions
vectors.description: Three versions; v3 adds carol and is submitted by bob. The head is v3, signers run genesis to head by first appearance. Implementations should also get the same report with the records shuffled.

vectors.name: verified-earlier-version-by-sch-id
vectors.description: Same paper as verified-three-versions, but head names sch:xxxx-xxxx-xxxx/v2: only v1 and v2 are followed, so carol is not a signer.

vectors.name: verified-paper-chosen-among-two
vectors.description: Two papers in one record set; paper= (the sch: id) selects the second.

vectors.name: verified-fork-resolved-by-naming-the-head
vectors.description: v2a and v2b both follow v1. Naming v2a as head verifies that branch; the sibling is ignored.

vectors.name: invalid-fork-without-a-chosen-head
vectors.description: v2a and v2b both follow v1 and nothing says which is newest: competing heads, nothing else can be checked.

vectors.name: invalid-tampered-head-body
vectors.description: The head version's title was changed after signing; its id and sig are stale.

vectors.name: invalid-tampered-older-version
vectors.description: v1's title was changed after v2 was signed: v1 fails its signature and v2's prev no longer matches v1's content.

vectors.name: invalid-tampered-genesis
vectors.description: The genesis body was changed after signing: bad signature and v1's prev no longer matches.

vectors.name: invalid-missing-consent
vectors.description: bob never consented to v1.

vectors.name: invalid-declined-consent
vectors.description: bob signed a consent to v1 whose decision is decline.

vectors.name: invalid-forged-consent-signature
vectors.description: bob's consent carries a signature made by mallory: it fails authentication and does not count.

vectors.name: invalid-missing-genesis
vectors.description: The genesis record is not in the set. Every record present authenticates, but prev links to the genesis cannot be checked.

vectors.name: invalid-missing-middle-version
vectors.description: v2 is absent: v1 and v3 are both unfollowed, so no head can be chosen and nothing else is checked.

vectors.name: invalid-missing-manifest
vectors.description: v1 names a manifest record that is not in the set.

vectors.name: retracted-by-author
vectors.description: alice retracts the paper: status retracted, but every integrity check still passes.

vectors.name: corrected-by-co-author
vectors.description: bob (a listed co-author who did not submit) files a correction naming v1.

vectors.name: retraction-by-outsider-is-not-applied
vectors.description: mallory is neither an author nor a trusted authority: the retraction is reported but not applied.

vectors.name: retracted-by-trusted-authority
vectors.description: The committee key is passed in authorities, so its retraction applies although it is not an author.

vectors.name: tombstoned-by-trusted-authority
vectors.description: The committee's tombstone of the paper applies: status tombstoned; the history still verifies.

vectors.name: tombstone-without-authority-is-advisory
vectors.description: The same tombstone without the committee in authorities is advisory: reported, not applied.

vectors.name: tombstone-of-earlier-version-leaves-head-verified
vectors.description: A trusted tombstone of v1 does not change the status of v2, the verified version.

vectors.name: retraction-outranks-tombstone-and-correction
vectors.description: All three notices apply; the status is the most severe (retracted > tombstoned > corrected). Supersessions are ordered by kind.

vectors.name: invalid-forged-retraction
vectors.description: A retraction naming the paper carries mallory's signature but alice as author: damaged notices fail the supersession check instead of vanishing.
